_meta.purpose: AI image generation prompts for /wildlife species card images. Use with DALL·E, Midjourney, or similar. Replace existing card images in app/wildlife/page.tsx.

_meta.vegetationContext: MIWESU Game Farm, Makoppa district, Thabazimbi, Limpopo. Arid Sweet Bushveld: reddish-brown soil, dry golden-brown grass, patchy green grass, acacia-like trees (flat-topped, thorny), gnarled dark-bark trees, thorny shrubs, dense bushveld thickets, dry season savanna. Warm, natural light; no power lines or man-made objects in frame.
_meta.styleRules: Warm wildlife photography. Shallow depth of field (subject sharp, background softly blurred). Average, typical specimen only (not 'largest', 'most beautiful', or 'trophy'). Natural pose in habitat. No blood, no gore. Dignified. Golden hour or soft overcast preferred.
